description: Audit Service Commission - National Audit Act. No. 19 of 2018
reasoning: This gazette content involves the publication of Performance Auditing Standards for the National Audit Office of Sri Lanka under the authority of the National Audit Act, No. 19 of 2018. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for performance audits, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
